description: Account Engagement Tracking and Consent loader on pi.pardot.com/pdt.js and pi.demand.salesforce.com/pdt.js. The generated snippet puts the integer account ID on aid. The published SPA example loads pdt.js without that query, so a missing aid is a warning. Legacy pd.js puts piAId in JavaScript and is not contracted.

params.name: aid
params.description: It is the Account Engagement account ID (piAId). The generated snippet loads pdt.js?aid= with that integer. The SPA example loads pdt.js without the query and passes the account ID to pdt('create') instead.
params.fix_hint: Copy the Tracking and Consent snippet so aid carries the account ID.
